## Professional Summary

Quantitative Senior Data Scientist with over 8 years of experience bridging rigorous statistical methodology with production-grade software engineering. Specialized in Decision Optimization under Uncertainty, Bayesian Statistics, Causal Inference, and A/B Experimentation. Proven track record of architecting end-to-end analytical solutions—from linear programming and hierarchical Bayesian modeling to containerized, production-ready web applications (PyShiny) and scalable GCP data pipelines. Adept at transforming ambiguous business problems into scientifically grounded algorithms that drive measurable margin and operational improvements.

---

## Key Competencies & Tech Stack

- **Optimization & Decision Making:** Constrained Optimization, Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP)
- **Statistical & Bayesian Modeling:** Hierarchical Bayesian Modeling, MCMC Simulation, Probabilistic Programming, Causal Inference.
- **Experimentation & Product Analytics:** Online A/B Testing Strategy, Experimental Design, Synthetic Controls
- **Programming & Libraries:** Python (PyMC, Pyomo, Scikit-learn, Polars, Pandas, PyShiny), R, Advanced SQL, PySpark.
- **Cloud, Infrastructure & MLOps:** GCP (BigQuery, Airflow), AWS, Snowflake, Redis, Docker, CI/CD, Git.
